primary.title: Mutual funds vs direct stocks: The hidden tax advantage on dividends that investors should know about
primary.summary: Mutual fund investors can benefit from a tax advantage on dividends received by schemes, as these dividends are not taxed at the scheme level. The full amount can remain invested and compound, unlike direct stock dividends, which are taxed at the investor’s slab rate.
